title: The home page videos and their lines show the app as it is today
why: Coach Milan 19 November 11:09: is it a good moment to update the home page and the videos? 14:23 to 14:26: all twelve videos on the build with DT307 and DT306, the home page text checked as its own step, on one board, then his Go. Recorded on 0.3.163 into a scratch folder; nothing on the home page is changed yet.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 19 November 2026, 11:09 and 14:26. A check on 0.3.163: eleven of the twelve videos were recorded on 1 November, the language video on 7 November.
opportunity.job: As a visitor of chefmealan.com, see what the app does before I join.
opportunity.kind: Looks broken: the videos and three lines show screens the app no longer has.
opportunity.why_now: 0.3.163 closed the read of a photo (DT307, DT306), the screen the meal and plate videos end on.

problem: A visitor watches the videos on the home page and sees the app of 1 November. The photo of a meal goes from the camera straight to the plate, with Fit to my target. The cook video starts on step 1. The plate's line says eat one portion or add a protein side. Then the visitor joins, takes a photo, and gets a photo screen, a read, and What do you do with it?. What they saw is not what they get.
story: When I watch the app on the home page, I want it to show the app I will get, so that what I try matches what I saw.

ac.title: Every video is of today's app
ac.text: Given the home page, when any of its twelve videos plays, then it shows the app as built in the release it ships in, and no screen older than 0.3.163.

ac.title: A photo of your meal
ac.text: Given the video A photo of your meal, when it plays, then it shows the camera, Use this photo, the photo screen with Read the plate, and the read with the foods named.

ac.title: Cook it, hands free
ac.text: Given the cook video, when it plays, then one tap turns the voice on, and words alone tick the five foods of Get it ready, go to step 1 and start its 6 minute timer.

ac.title: The rules of the videos
ac.text: Given the videos are recorded, when the recording ends, then every rule HC1 to HC13 has passed, and a rule that fails replaces no video.

ac.title: Then you decide
ac.text: Given the plate section of the home page, when I read Then you decide, then it says save it, plan it, or log what you ate of it, all of it or a part, or let Chef Mealan fit it to your target.

ac.title: The cook lines
ac.text: Given the cook section of the home page, when I read its first line and the video's name, then they say the foods come first and the steps after them, one at a time.

ac.title: In three languages
ac.text: Given the three changed lines, when the home page is in Serbian or German, then each shows in that language.

ac.title: The note says the version they were recorded on
ac.text: Given the videos recorded on 0.3.164, when I read the note under them, then it says Clips of the app, version 0.3.164, on test data, and the version comes from the recording, so it is never a version the videos were not made on.

Test data only: the made-up packs and names.

now: Eleven videos from 1 November and the language video from 7 November. Three lines describe the plate and cook mode as they were then.
proposed: All twelve videos recorded again on 0.3.163 by the recording script, which checks its rules on every video. The script follows the app where its flows changed: the camera opens with Photo or scan, a photo waits on the photo screen and is read there, a cook starts with Get it ready. Three lines get new words, in English, Serbian and German. Nothing else on the page changes.
decision: Go, Coach Milan 19 November 15:29, for AC1 to AC7. AC8 (the version in the note) drawn the same day, after his question; waits for its Go.
details: Recorded with scripts/record-home-clips.cjs on 0.3.163, every rule HC1 to HC13 passed. With the Go the files go into public/landing in the release.

Four changes to the script, none to the app: the camera button of the empty Plate, the meal video through the photo screen to the read, the cook video through Get it ready, and the stand-in voice ends its sentences as a phone does.
The stills on this board are taken from the videos: one early, one in the middle, the last settled screen.
Words only for the lines: English, Serbian, German.
